## Football effect

Johnson missed the August 9 to 13 sessions; the August 10 reassessment did not change the instruction. His projected return is the August 14 game date itself, and Stone decided in his [Chicago plan](../../../04_Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Preseason_Games/Game_02/Preseason%20Game%202_%20HC.md) that Johnson does not play at Chicago whatever the reassessment says, a football decision: Cornelius Lucas holds the first-group right tackle for that one game, not a depth-chart award. The arrangement after Chicago follows Johnson's actual clearance. A clearance does not automatically restore the previous role.
